title: android-emu-build
description: The app's facts for Release Android emulator builds. Read by scripts/build/build-android-emu.ts and by the android-emulator-build skill's checkers. Every key is optional.

avdPrefix.description: Emulators are AVDs named <avdPrefix>-<purpose>; only prefixed AVDs are created, stopped or deleted, and tooling may name no other AVD. Default: the package.json name in kebab case.

device.description: The avdmanager hardware profile of a newly created AVD, and the screenshot size check-emu-screenshot expects. Default: pixel_8 (1080 x 2400).

systemImage.description: A system image other than the pinned one (system-images;android-36;google_apis;<host ABI>), for example one already installed. Its ABI must be the ABI the build targets.

appId.description: The production applicationId; development and preview must be <appId>.dev and <appId>.preview. Default: only the suffix is checked.

postPrebuild.description: npm scripts run from the repo root after every prebuild (an audit that reads android/); the preflight refuses a missing one. Default: none.

targetSdk.description: The targetSdkVersion every APK carries. Default: ANDROID_API in scripts/android/toolchain.ts, else 36.

minSdk.description: The minSdkVersion every APK carries (never below 24, the React Native 0.86 floor). Default: only the floor is checked.

permissions.description: Every uses-permission the merged manifest may carry. A permission a library adds at Gradle merge time and this list lacks fails check-apk. The seed is what the Expo SDK 57 prebuild template always adds (INTERNET, SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW, VIBRATE, READ/WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE up to API 32): keep each one on purpose or remove it with android.blockedPermissions. A name after the app's own package is written ${applicationId}.NAME and resolves per variant; an app-own signature permission the APK declares (androidx.core's DYNAMIC_RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED_PERMISSION) needs no entry. Absent: not checked (check-apk prints what it found).

application.description: Attributes of the <application> element with an exact value, without the android: prefix, for example { "allowBackup": false }.

abi.description: The ABI an APK must hold native libraries for (lib/<abi>/). Default: arm64-v8a or x86_64, either one.

readyLog.description: A logcat line the test build writes once its first screen is interactive: { tag, contains }. null: the run waits for a still screen.
